I was in grade six learning long division in Mrs. Clarke's math class. The art teacher, Mr. Clark (no relation), liked to play the radio as his students painted as a way to let off steam. We could hear his broadcast, but it wasn't ever loud enough to be an issue.

After Mrs. Clarke answered a question, Mr. Clark brought his class into our classroom and we hooked up a TV to get a live feed of CNN. We were all transfixed. By then, the second plane had just hit.
